I am an old man, 77 years, and I have been growing maize on this land for many years. My body is tired now, so I must rely on my children and sometimes pay for ganyu labor when the weeding time comes. I will try to get the FISP coupon this year as I always do — without the subsidy fertilizer, maize will not yield well on our soils here in Mulanje. I will also put some manure from the goats at the planting station, and plant the hybrid seed the extension worker brings, because local seed does not respond well to the fertilizer.
